setup_notes: The default MIDI channel is 16. Hold FX SELECT to enter CONFIG, select CHANNEL, press FX SELECT to highlight the current channel, rotate to choose a channel and press to confirm.
Use FX SELECT to choose EXIT from CHANNEL, then EXIT from CONFIG. The selected MIDI channel persists when power is switched off.
